page.overview:
Who is WGP Security Guard?

The WGP Security Guard is a security officer for the World Grand Prix in Tokyo, Japan. It's unknown that he didn't in Cars 2, as one of the security officers at the Tokyo Grand Prix. He appeared as die-cast for 2012 mainline. It's possible that perhaps he was portrayed in the movie as a security officer at Haneda Airport in Tokyo, just like Murakarmi.
